_comment: THIS TREE'S OWN IDENTITY — the FROM side of every rebrand. tooling/rebrand/rebrand.mjs reads it to know what to rename AWAY from; a product's identity is the --values file, which is the TO side. Change a value here only together with the tree: these strings must be what the tree actually contains, or the rename silently misses and the product ships carrying this baseline's name. `productName` is the SITE_NAME seam in apps/web/lib/site.ts; `slug` also names the D1 databases (terraform `repo`), the db-migrate parameters and the secret project; `pascal` is the code-identifier form, which nothing here spells (the upstream project is `UptimeFlare`, a different string the rename leaves alone); `domain` and `subdomain` are placeholders, because this baseline has never deployed under a name of its own; `githubOwner` is the owner in SOURCE_URL.
